restaurant_name: Dog and Cat Rescue Samui Foundation Ban Taling Ngam
text:
I have volunteered at Dog and Cat Rescue Koh Samui for some time, and I continue to be amazed by the incredible work they do every day. Caring for more than 400 dogs and over 100 cats is a huge undertaking, yet the staff and volunteers provide outstanding care, dedication, and compassion to every animal.

What impressed me most is how much they achieve with the donations they receive. Every contribution is clearly put to good use, helping improve the lives of hundreds of animals who otherwise would have very few options. The atmosphere is welcoming, the team is passionate, and the impact they make on Koh Samui is truly remarkable.

I highly recommend visiting the shelter, volunteering, or simply taking one of the dogs for a walk. It’s a wonderful experience and a great way to support an organization that is making a real difference every single day.

text:

The dogs were incredibly sweet and friendly, and it was obvious how much love and care they receive.  Even the other individuals visiting were a delight to meet .

The volunteers are truly the heart of this place. Kind, dedicated, and clearly passionate about animal welfare, they make the sanctuary feel more like a community than a shelter. Everything is well-organized and thoughtfully run.

I initially felt a bit apprehensive about visiting a shelter with so many animals, but I was quickly reassured. The dogs are happy, healthy, and clearly well looked after. The whole visit left me feeling uplifted and inspired. Special thanks Hasse, David and Marcus

I was so moved by the experience that I now sponsor four dogs. It’s a small way to give back to a place that gives so much. Highly recommend for anyone who wants to make a difference or simply connect with some amazing animals and people.

restaurant_name: Dog and Cat Rescue Samui Foundation Ban Taling Ngam
text:

The Dog and Cat Rescue foundation are doing an amazing job looking after all the animals. Although there are a lot of dogs and cats, they have large areas which are separated to ensure they dogs get along. They seem to be happy and looked after being fed large meals of rice and veg and donations from the public.

If you decide to visit, please bring large bags of food and anything else you can spare as they can always do with more for the animals.

2pm ish you can also take the dogs to the beach for a walk and play. Unfortunately some dogs have some life long injuries , so may just want to sit and be stroked, but it’s great to give them the interaction

Please also make sure you take the time to walk all the way to the back as the place is huge and it’s likely that the dogs in the rear do not get as much interaction

restaurant_name: Dog and Cat Rescue Samui Foundation Ban Taling Ngam
text:
I spent two weeks volunteering at this shelter and I cannot recommend it enough!
Doesn’t matter if it’s just for a day or up to a few months, this is the place for animal lovers.
I was very close to canceling my travel plans and going home. The work here gave me purpose to work through it!
It’s located in the more secluded/jungly side of Koh Samui, so the scenery is beautiful!
The daily schedule was very similar from day to day: we started with cleaning the puppy area (and of course lots of cuddles) and went on to prepare and give extra food to the sicker/skinnier dogs in the morning.
We always grabbed lunch with the volunteering staff, so there’s a nice sense of community.
In the afternoon we helped cleaning the cat compartments as well as cleaning their ears/eyes if needed and went on a walk with different dogs every day (so everyone gets out) and went to the beach! On some days we took the truck with the older/disabled dogs, so they could enjoy moving in the ocean!
Altogether, you could tell the dogs and cats were being taken good care of.
There’s lots of different compartments with so many beautiful souls, that you’ll absolutely fall in love with.
I was very sad to leave, especially without being able to adopt a furry friend, but I’ll for sure (!!!) come back to volunteer again and next time, I won’t be going home alone!

text:
I was incredibly fortunate to learn about the work of Dog & Cat Rescue Samui – and I'm deeply impressed. Since its founding in 1999, they have been tirelessly helping street dogs and cats on Koh Samui. The team works with unbelievable passion, dedication, and professionalism.

It's especially touching to see how lovingly the animals are cared for, given medical treatment, and prepared for a better life. Many of them have been through difficult times – here they get a real second chance.

The organization is committed not only to rescue and care but also to sustainable solutions such as spay/neuter programs and education. This demonstrates their long-term thinking and approach.

Anyone who loves animals should definitely support this organization – whether through donations, volunteering, or simply by recommending their important work. Dog & Cat Rescue Samui is a shining example of how much good people can achieve.

Highly recommended! 🐾
